feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: Breweries adapt as tastes in beer change
entry.summary: The craft beer market is saturated and tastes are changing. Brewers are coming with innovative ways to attract customers.

entry.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
entry.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.

entry.title: Egg prices have tumbled since Trump returned to office. Here's why
entry.summary: Agriculture experts say high egg prices were the result of severe avian flu outbreaks, but the Trump administration's tariffs and the war with Iran have also put pressure on farmers.

entry.title: Trade tensions mean fewer Canadians flocking to South Florida
entry.summary: This South Florida community is typically a refuge for Canadians fleeing cold weather, but trade tensions between the United States and Canada mean fewer are coming.

entry.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
entry.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

entry.title: One year after the end of the EV tax credit, is the future still electric?
entry.summary: Congress got rid of a $7,500 federal tax credit for new electric vehicle buyers. One year later, are people still buying EVs?

entry.title: How to hide your spending habits from retailers (so you don't get ripped off)
entry.summary: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

entry.title: Democrat Pete Buttigieg criticizes Trump's rollback of fuel-economy standards
entry.summary: The former transportation secretary says weaker fuel-economy standards could raise long-term costs for drivers and leave U.S. automakers further behind China.

entry.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
entry.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

entry.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
entry.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.
